issue: Exact duplicate rows
reason: A repeated row would double-count a transaction.

issue: Duplicate transaction_id
reason: transaction_id must be a unique key.

issue: Same content under different ids
reason: Catches re-keyed duplicates that an id check misses.

issue: Date and time stored as text
action: Combined into one datetime column; 0 failed to parse
reason: Text dates cannot be sorted, split by year or used for a time-based split.

issue: Rows dated outside 2019-2023
action: Kept; flagged dq_outside_window and excluded from per-year charts
reason: All are 2024-01-01: a partial single day that would distort yearly totals.

issue: transaction_hour disagrees with transaction_time
reason: A redundant column can silently drift from its source.

issue: Values outside the allowed set: account_type
reason: Typos or new codes would split one category into several.

issue: Values outside the allowed set: transaction_type
reason: Typos or new codes would split one category into several.

issue: Values outside the allowed set: transaction_direction
reason: Typos or new codes would split one category into several.

issue: Values outside the allowed set: transaction_status
reason: Typos or new codes would split one category into several.

issue: Values outside the allowed set: channel
reason: Typos or new codes would split one category into several.

issue: Values outside the allowed set: kyc_status
reason: Typos or new codes would split one category into several.

issue: Inconsistent state naming ('UP' abbreviation)
reason: Other nine states use full names; mixed forms break grouping and joins.

issue: loan_type blank because customer has no loan
reason: Structurally missing, not unknown: has_loan = 0 and emi_amount = 0.

issue: loan_type blank although has_loan = 1
reason: Genuinely missing. Guessing a loan type would invent data.

issue: has_loan and emi_amount disagree
reason: A loan with no EMI, or an EMI with no loan, would be a contradiction.

issue: Value outside valid range: transaction_amount
reason: Amounts and balances must be positive; CIBIL scores run 300-900.

issue: Value outside valid range: account_balance
reason: Amounts and balances must be positive; CIBIL scores run 300-900.

issue: Value outside valid range: credit_score
reason: Amounts and balances must be positive; CIBIL scores run 300-900.

issue: Value outside valid range: is_fraud
reason: Amounts and balances must be positive; CIBIL scores run 300-900.

issue: Amounts of Rs 10 lakh or more (extreme right tail)
action: Kept; analysed on a log scale
reason: Mean Rs 29,907 vs median Rs 2,036. Large transfers are real and are where fraud concentrates, so deleting them would remove the signal.

issue: Amounts exactly at Rs 1 crore (looks like a generator cap)
reason: A pile-up at a round maximum suggests values were clipped.

issue: Balance at Rs 500 floor or Rs 50 lakh cap
reason: 288 at floor, 38 at cap: true values are unknown beyond these limits.

issue: Debit larger than the account balance
action: Kept; flagged dq_exceeds_balance and tested for association with fraud
reason: Possible only with an overdraft, or if the balance is recorded after the debit. The field's meaning is undocumented, so it is not 'corrected'.

issue: RTGS below the Rs 2 lakh RBI minimum
reason: Breaks a payment-system rule, so the type label or the amount is wrong. We cannot tell which, so neither is changed.

issue: Merchant category 'Salary' on a debit
reason: Salary is money received. Two thirds of 'Salary' rows are debits, so merchant_category is weakly reliable.

issue: ATM withdrawal not via ATM, or POS not via POS terminal
reason: 48456 ATM + 53464 POS rows. Channel looks independent of type, so channel findings are treated with caution.

issue: Fixed-deposit account used for retail payments
reason: Fixed deposits do not support UPI, POS, card, ATM or auto-debit.

issue: Same customer_id with different account_type or state
action: Kept; 79,259 of 79,916 customers affected, so rows are treated as independent
reason: customer_id is not a stable entity here; per-customer history features would be meaningless.

issue: Successful transaction while KYC is Pending or Expired
action: Kept; reported as a compliance finding
reason: Not a data error: it describes a control gap the bank may care about.

issue: Skewed amounts and ratios
reason: Log scale makes a 2-to-1e7 range usable in charts and analysis..

issue: Low-cardinality text columns stored as strings
action: Converted to category dtype (164 MB -> 86 MB)
reason: Same values, far less memory and faster group-bys.
